vsm1.4:107.1: Uppannesu hi etesu pañcasu jhānaṃ uppannaṃ nāma hoti.
vsm1.4:107.3: Tasmā na etehi samannāgataṃ aññadeva jhānaṃ nāma atthīti gahetabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:107.8: pañcaṅgikanti vā pañcaṅgasamannāgatanti vā vuccatīti veditabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:108.1: Etāni ca pañcaṅgāni kiñcāpi upacārakkhaṇepi atthi, atha kho upacāre pakaticittato balavatarāni.
vsm1.4:108.3: Ettha hi vitakko suvisadena ākārena ārammaṇe cittaṃ abhiniropayamāno uppajjati.
vsm1.4:108.6: Tenevāha – ‘‘nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hotī’’ti (dī. ni. 1.228).
vsm1.4:108.7: Cittekaggatāpi heṭṭhimamhi samuggapaṭale uparimaṃ samuggapaṭalaṃ viya ārammaṇesu phusitā hutvā uppajjati,
vsm1.4:109.1: Tattha cittekaggatā kiñcāpi savitakkaṃ savicāranti imasmiṃ pāṭhe
vsm1.4:109.4: ‘‘jhānanti vitakko vicāro pīti sukhaṃ cittassekaggatā’’ti (vibha. 569) evaṃ vuttattā aṅgameva.
vsm1.4:109.5: Yena hi adhippāyena bhagavatā uddeso kato,
vsm1.4:110.2: Tesaṃyeva ca ādimajjhapariyosānānaṃ lakkhaṇavasena dasalakkhaṇasampannatā veditabbā.
vsm1.4:111.3: paṭhamassa jhānassa paṭipadāvisuddhi ādi, ādissa kati lakkhaṇāni?
vsm1.4:111.4: Ādissa tīṇi lakkhaṇāni, yo tassa paribandho, tato cittaṃ visujjhati,
vsm1.4:111.8: yañca visuddhattā cittaṃ majjhimaṃ samathanimittaṃ paṭipajjati,
vsm1.4:111.10: Paṭhamassa jhānassa paṭipadāvisuddhi ādi, ādissa imāni tīṇi lakkhaṇāni.
vsm1.4:111.11: Tena vuccati paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ ādikalyāṇañceva hoti tilakkhaṇasampannañca.
vsm1.4:112.1: ‘‘Paṭhamassa jhānassa upekkhānubrūhanā majjhe, majjhassa kati lakkhaṇāni?
vsm1.4:112.2: Majjhassa tīṇi lakkhaṇāni, visuddhaṃ cittaṃ ajjhupekkhati,
vsm1.4:112.8: Paṭhamassa jhānassa upekkhānubrūhanā majjhe, majjhassa imāni tīṇi lakkhaṇāni.
vsm1.4:112.9: Tena vuccati paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ majjhekalyāṇañceva hoti tilakkhaṇasampannañca.
vsm1.4:113.1: ‘‘Paṭhamassa jhānassa sampahaṃsanā pariyosānaṃ, pariyosānassa kati lakkhaṇāni?
vsm1.4:113.2: Pariyosānassa cattāri lakkhaṇāni, tattha jātānaṃ dhammānaṃ anativattanaṭṭhena sampahaṃsanā,
vsm1.4:113.6: Paṭhamassa jhānassa sampahaṃsanā pariyosānaṃ, pariyosānassa imāni cattāri lakkhaṇāni.
vsm1.4:113.7: Tena vuccati paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇañceva hoti catulakkhaṇasampannañcā’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.158).
vsm1.4:114.5: upekkhānubrūhitañca ñāṇena ca sampahaṃsita’’nti (paṭi. ma. 1.158) pāḷiyaṃ vuttaṃ,
vsm1.4:114.8: dhammānaṃ anativattanādibhāvasādhanena pariyodāpakassa ñāṇassa kiccanipphattivasena sampahaṃsanā ca veditabbā.
vsm1.4:115.2: tasmiṃ yo nīvaraṇasaṅkhāto kilesagaṇo tassa jhānassa paribandho, tato cittaṃ visujjhati.
vsm1.4:115.7: majjhimaṃ samathanimittaṃ paṭipajjati nāma, evaṃ paṭipannattā tathattupagamanena tattha pakkhandati nāma.
vsm1.4:115.9: paṭhamassa jhānassa uppādakkhaṇeyeva āgamanavasena paṭipadāvisuddhi veditabbā.
vsm1.4:116.1: Evaṃ visuddhassa pana tassa puna visodhetabbābhāvato visodhane byāpāraṃ akaronto
vsm1.4:116.3: Samathabhāvupagamanena samathapaṭipannassa puna samādhāne byāpāraṃ akaronto
vsm1.4:116.5: Samathapaṭipannabhāvato eva cassa kilesasaṃsaggaṃ pahāya ekattena upaṭṭhitassa puna ekattupaṭṭhāne byāpāraṃ akaronto
vsm1.4:117.2: tattha jātā samādhipaññāsaṅkhātā yuganaddhadhammā aññamaññaṃ anativattamānā hutvā pavattā,
vsm1.4:117.3: yāni ca saddhādīni indriyāni nānākilesehi vimuttattā
vsm1.4:117.5: yañcesa tadupagaṃ tesaṃ anativattanaekarasabhāvānaṃ anucchavikaṃ vīriyaṃ vāhayati,
vsm1.4:117.6: yā cassa tasmiṃ khaṇe pavattā āsevanā,
vsm1.4:117.7: sabbepi te ākārā yasmā ñāṇena saṃkilesavodānesu taṃ taṃ ādīnavañca ānisaṃsañca disvā
vsm1.4:117.8: tathā tathā sampahaṃsitattā visodhitattā pariyodāpitattā nipphannāva,
vsm1.4:118.1: Tattha yasmā upekkhāvasena ñāṇaṃ pākaṭaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:119.1: Idāni paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ adhigataṃ hoti pathavīkasiṇanti ettha
vsm1.4:119.6: Tatra imasmiṃ atthe jhānaṃ pathavīkasiṇanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:119.7: Taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ ‘‘paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ adhigataṃ hoti pathavīkasiṇa’’nti.
vsm1.4:120.1: Evamadhigate pana etasmiṃ tena yoginā vālavedhinā viya,
vsm1.4:120.3: Yathā hi sukusalo dhanuggaho vālavedhāya kammaṃ kurumāno yasmiṃ vāre vālaṃ vijjhati,
vsm1.4:120.4: tasmiṃ vāre akkantapadānañca dhanudaṇḍassa ca jiyāya ca sarassa ca ākāraṃ pariggaṇheyya.
vsm1.4:120.5: ‘‘Evaṃ me ṭhitena evaṃ dhanudaṇḍaṃ evaṃ jiyaṃ evaṃ saraṃ gahetvā vālo viddho’’ti.
vsm1.4:120.6: So tato paṭṭhāya tatheva te ākāre sampādento avirādhetvā vālaṃ vijjheyya.
vsm1.4:120.7: Evameva yogināpi ‘‘imaṃ nāma me bhojanaṃ bhuñjitvā evarūpaṃ puggalaṃ sevamānena
vsm1.4:120.9: iminā nāma iriyāpathena imasmiṃ kāle idaṃ adhigata’’nti ete bhojanasappāyādayo ākārā pariggahetabbā.
vsm1.4:120.10: Evañhi so naṭṭhe vā tasmiṃ te ākāre sampādetvā puna uppādetuṃ,
vsm1.4:120.11: appaguṇaṃ vā paguṇaṃ karonto punappunaṃ appetuṃ sakkhissati.
vsm1.4:121.1: Yathā ca kusalo sūdo bhattāraṃ parivisanto tassa yaṃ yaṃ ruciyā bhuñjati, taṃ taṃ sallakkhetvā
vsm1.4:121.2: tato paṭṭhāya tādisameva upanāmento lābhassa bhāgī hoti,
vsm1.4:121.4: te sampādento naṭṭhe naṭṭhe punappunaṃ appanāya lābhī hoti.
vsm1.4:121.5: Tasmā tena vālavedhinā viya sūdena viya ca ākārā pariggahetabbā.
vsm1.4:122.1: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattaṃ vā nānaccayehi sūpehi paccupaṭṭhito assa ambilaggehipi tittakaggehipi kaṭukaggehipi madhuraggehipi khārikehipi akhārikehipi loṇikehipi aloṇikehipi.
vsm1.4:122.2: Sa kho so, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu nimittaṃ uggaṇhāti ‘idaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, imassa vā abhiharati, imassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, imassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, ambilaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, ambilaggassa vā abhiharati, ambilaggassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, ambilaggassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati…pe… aloṇikassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatī’ti.
vsm1.4:122.3: Sa kho so, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo lābhī ceva hoti acchādanassa, lābhī vetanassa, lābhī abhihārānaṃ.
vsm1.4:122.4: Taṃ kissa hetu? Tathā hi so, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu nimittaṃ uggaṇhāti.
vsm1.4:122.5: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco paṇḍito byatto kusalo bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati…pe… vedanāsu vedanā… citte cittā… dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato cittaṃ samādhiyati, upakkilesā pahīyanti,
vsm1.4:122.7: Sa kho so, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo bhikkhu lābhī ceva hoti diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ, lābhī satisampajaññassa.
vsm1.4:122.8: Taṃ kissa hetu? Tathā hi so, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo bhikkhu sakassa cittassa nimittaṃ uggaṇhātī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.374).
vsm1.4:123.1: Nimittaggahaṇena cassa puna te ākāre sampādayato appanāmattameva ijjhati, na ciraṭṭhānaṃ.
vsm1.4:123.2: Ciraṭṭhānaṃ pana samādhiparibandhānaṃ dhammānaṃ suvisodhitattā hoti.
vsm1.4:124.1: Yo hi bhikkhu kāmādīnavapaccavekkhaṇādīhi kāmacchandaṃ na suṭṭhu vikkhambhetvā,
vsm1.4:124.5: aññepi samādhiparibandhe dhamme na suṭṭhu visodhetvā jhānaṃ samāpajjati,
vsm1.4:124.6: so avisodhitaṃ āsayaṃ paviṭṭhabhamaro viya avisuddhaṃ uyyānaṃ paviṭṭharājā viya ca khippameva nikkhamati.
vsm1.4:125.1: Yo pana samādhiparibandhe dhamme suṭṭhu visodhetvā jhānaṃ samāpajjati,
vsm1.4:125.2: so suvisodhitaṃ āsayaṃ paviṭṭhabhamaro viya suparisuddhaṃ uyyānaṃ paviṭṭharājā viya ca sakalampi divasabhāgaṃ antosamāpattiyaṃyeva hoti.
vsm1.4:125.5: Vivekapāmojjakarena cetasā, Rājāva suddhantagato tahiṃ rame’’ti.
vsm1.4:126.1: Tasmā ciraṭṭhitikāmena paribandhakadhamme visodhetvā jhānaṃ samāpajjitabbaṃ.
